title: Remove click monitoring after ending statistics
goal: calls removeEventListener on the same event and the same function reference.
summary: Get the cumulative number of forms issued by clicks on the reading table. After this round ends, the access button will still be displayed but clicking will no longer modify the count.
tasks: Increase the number displayed by #served by one when #serve is clicked.
Click #stop to remove the registered reading monitoring. Any clicks thereafter will not be added to the record.

example.note: Adding and removing refer to the same function. Even if the codes of two different functions are exactly the same, they cannot be interchanged.

hint: Declare a named function, and then give the same function to addEventListener and removeEventListener respectively.
